personality_one_liner: A high-tech, tactical command center for real-time card evaluation, where live camera data and holographic amber accents dominate.

spacing.rule: Dense and tactical. Use tighter margins for data sets, but leave breathing room around the live camera reticle.

do's: Use heavily tinted dark glass (expo-blur dark tint) for the live card overlay panel at the bottom of the camera screen.
Use frosted pill containers for the top voice waveform indicator floating over the camera.
dont's: Do not use glass on settings or history lists. Keep those solid dark utility surfaces.

screens.name: Scanner (Home)
screens.purpose: A live camera feed overlay that constantly evaluates the card in view and speaks/listens for queries.

states.empty: Camera feed running with targeting reticle and waiting for card...
states.error: Camera access denied message or API error overlay

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera feed background. Top safe area: A floating pill containing an animated waveform for the AI voice assistant (syncs with listening/speaking states). Center: A subtle tracking reticle (corner brackets). Bottom 1/3: A floating, heavily tinted dark glassmorphic card that snaps up when a card is identified. This card displays the Card Name (Rajdhani font), Set name, Rarity, and a strict tabular breakdown of Low/Mid/High prices with Market Price in large bold text in the brandPrimary color.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: A scannable log of all recently identified cards and their checked prices.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty dark shelf with a message 'No cards scanned yet.'

screens.layout: Solid dark background (surface). Dense, utility-first list view. Each row shows a small square thumbnail of the card, Name, Set, and the Market Price right-aligned. Tapping a row opens a detailed modal. Use hairline borders to separate rows.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Tactical configuration for the scanner, voice, and API connections.
screens.layout: Standard dark utility forms. Group settings into sections (Scanner, Voice Assistant, API Keys). Use standard switches for Voice On/Off, and text inputs for API configurations. Ensure inputs use surfaceTertiary backgrounds with borderStrong on focus.

camera_mock_background.alt: Mock camera feed showing a holographic Charizard card on a table.

history_empty_state.alt: An empty, dimly lit wooden shelf room.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design the Scanner screen to mimic a live camera UI. If `expo-camera` is not testable in the web environment, use the `camera_mock_background` image as an absolute-filled background to simulate the live feed.
The primary aesthetic is a 'Dark-First Utility' command center. Use Rajdhani for all numbers, prices, and main headings to give it a techy, precise look.
The voice assistant waveform should sit in a frosted glass pill near the top of the Scanner screen. Use `brandPrimary` (amber) for the waveform visualization.
Do NOT use any shades of blue, purple, or indigo anywhere in the app. Use the provided Amber (#FFB800) and Obsidian/Graphite palette strictly.
For the bottom card info overlay on the Scanner screen, use `expo-blur` with a dark tint and high intensity so the camera feed barely bleeds through, ensuring perfect text readability.
Include haptics (`expo-haptics`) mapped to the interactions specified in the haptics block.
